_comment: What a non-2xx answer from the usage endpoint means, in one contract every port shares. `signInAgain` is the only outcome no amount of retrying fixes: the credentials themselves are finished, so the panels must stop drawing that account's bars as if they were current and say so instead. `retryable` keeps the last good reading up while the next poll tries again. `label` names a saved account in the message; without one the message is the LIVE login's, and it carries the refresh hint - clients never write that token, so Claude Code's own refresh is the only cure. Pinned across lib/pure/usage.js (GNOME), claude-code/normalize.js (CLI + MCP + status line) and ClaudeUsageCore/HttpFailure.swift (macOS).
